version.description: The plugin version answering the call.

secrets.description: Each declared secret name mapped to whether Orbit delivered a non-empty value (an empty string reads as unset, matching model routing). Never a value.

baseten_token.description: Deprecated alias of open_weights_token, kept for one release (STD-01 R35); mirrors its value.

open_weights_token_binding.description: Where the stored open_weights_token may be sent. this_endpoint: it was saved for the configured endpoint's origin (scheme, host and port), so private calls there send it. other_endpoint: it was saved for another origin, or no endpoint is configured; nothing sends it. unbound: stored without an origin (for example a bare token), never sent. unset: no token. Never the token or its origin.

library.description: Library and index health. Counts come from the index; an uninitialized Library reports zero counts.

pages_off_template.description: Knowledge pages that name a template and no longer meet its current rules. Pages with no template field are not counted.

template_invalid.description: Library-relative paths of template files that do not parse, sorted. Empty when every template file is valid. A broken template does not fail the status call.

hosted.description: The hosted route normal material uses: the configured models.endpoint and models (the defaults while unset: Meta's Model API, muse-spark-1.3, muse-wonder and muse-voice-transcribe-1.0). The endpoint never carries credentials; its key is secrets.meta_api_key.

endpoint.description: OpenAI-compatible base URL hosted calls go to.

standard.description: Model for extraction and image reading.

open_weights.description: The configured private endpoint, or null when none is configured. The token is never included; see secrets.open_weights_token.

endpoint.description: OpenAI-compatible base URL the user chose.

model.description: The model name as that server names it.

label.description: Shown wherever the route is used.

capabilities.description: What the last check accepted, in check order, or null until a check has recorded them.

verified_at.description: When the last check ran (RFC 3339), or null until then.

shared.description: The configured team shared library, or null when none is configured. The remote never carries credentials.

remote.description: ssh://, scp-style, HTTPS without user information, or an absolute repository path.

member.description: This member's lowercase kebab-case name, recorded as shared_by.

brief.description: The followed extra Orbit workspace selectors (brief.task_workspaces), exactly as configured and in order, or null when the Library is uninitialized. Unset reads as an empty task_workspaces.

task_workspaces.description: Extra Orbit workspace selectors the session brief merges, in configured order, with no resolution or reachability check.

meetings.description: Meeting to-do routing (meetings.agent_workspace), or null when the Library is uninitialized.

agent_workspace.description: The Orbit workspace selector that receives agent-owned code to-dos from meeting extraction; null keeps every meeting to-do owner:you.

precedents.description: The effective decision-precedent recency from the Library settings (precedents.half_life_days, default 90). Never null: an unset key, or an uninitialized Library, reads as the default.
